scope.selection_rule: All materialized MEDIUM candidates with preliminary_risk_score >= 6 on the merged Band-V-B-HIGH basis.

records.text: Für Hyperzeit müsste ein eigener RG-Fluss zu einem stabilen z=1-Sektor hergeleitet werden.
records.context_basis: The surrounding RG section states that emergent Lorentz symmetry in another system does not prove emergence from HPVS; the sentence itself uses the counterfactual requirement 'müsste ... hergeleitet werden'.

records.text: DESI/KiDS bestätigen Hyperzeit oder liefern bessere Fits als LambdaCDM.
records.context_basis: The statement is inside the 'Claim Firewall' section, carries the tag 'not admissible', and is followed by the explicit statement that no released complete forward map or validated joint likelihood exists and K1-E remains inadmissible.

records.text: 6D parent parameters -> 4D EFT -> observables -> instrument/selection model -> likelihood
records.context_basis: The immediately following guide text states that observational comparison becomes admissible only when every required map is released and provenance-controlled; the guide also states that a fitted parameter is not a six-dimensional derivation.

records.text: Curated English Hyperzeit Material Atlas 2.0: literature context, mixed-term derivation, radion potential, stability, observables, no-go theorems, DeWitt metric and BRST.
records.context_basis: The atlas lead explicitly says literature compatibility is not treated as derivation or evidence for Hyperzeit. The mixed-term statement is scoped to the displayed 3+2 product-geometry extrinsic-curvature calculation; radion stability is conditional on model assumptions and canonical normalization.

records.text: Hyperzeit Materialatlas 2.0: Fachliteratur, Mischterm-Herleitung, Radionpotential, Stabilitätsbaum, Observablen, No-Go-Theoreme, DeWitt-Metrik, BRST und 50 Quellen.
records.context_basis: The page states that the literature-status column describes the role of a source, not confirmation of HZT, and that observables are data references only after forward-model release. The mixed-term derivation is a bounded geometry calculation, not a complete 6D parent-to-observable derivation.

records.text: 6D parameters -> 4D EFT -> observables -> instrument response -> selection -> background model -> likelihood.
records.context_basis: The same card states that DESI, Pantheon+, KiDS/DES, RSD, SPARC and GW data become theory tests only after a released forward map exists and that a good fit without that derivation is not evidence for Hyperzeit.

records.text: MOND ist exakt aus 6D hergeleitet und benötigt keine freien Parameter.
records.context_basis: The statement is inside the 'Claim Firewall' section, carries the tag 'historical', and is followed by the explicit statement that a0, MDAR and BTFR remain historical/phenomenological approaches and that no current parent derivation exists.

records.text: Hilbertraum, RG, kontrollierte 6D->4D-Reduktion, Likelihood- und Solverstandards.
records.context_basis: The text is the description of the Methods & QA navigation card under a section that explicitly separates readable documentation and current work states from historical audits. It names catalogue topics and does not state that the parent reduction or likelihood has been completed.

interpretation_rule: Manual contextual adjudication of a lexical MEDIUM candidate does not establish the truth of the corresponding physical proposition and does not create evidence.
